title_zh: 用对抗性例子评估和增强基于神经网络的依存句法分析模型的鲁棒性
title_en: Evaluating and Enhancing the Robustness of Neural Network-based Dependency Parsing Models with Adversarial Examples
authors: Minhao Cheng；Xiaoqing Zheng；Yi Zhou；Cho-Jui Hsieh；Xuanjing Huang；Jiehang Zeng
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 情感理解
abstract_zh: 尽管神经网络在许多重要任务上取得了突出的表现，但据报道，神经网络很容易受到对抗性例子的影响。以前的研究主要集中在情感分析、问答和阅读理解等语义任务上。在这项研究中，我们表明依存句法分析中也存在对抗性例子：我们提出了两种方法来研究解析器在句子和短语级别上对现有文本的扰动搜索在哪里以及如何犯错，并设计算法在黑盒和短语中构造这样的例子。白盒设置。我们在 English Penn Treebank (PTB) 上使用最先进的解析器之一进行的实验表明，高达 77% 的输入示例承认...
abstract_en: Despite achieving prominent performance on many important tasks, it has been reported that neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial examples.Previously studies along this line mainly focused on semantic tasks such as sentiment analysis, question answering and reading comprehension.In this study, we show that adversarial examples also exist in dependency parsing: we propose two approaches to study where and how parsers make mistakes by searching over perturbations to existing texts at sentence and phrase levels, and design algorithms to construct such examples in both of the black-box and white-box settings.Our experiments with one of state-of-the-art parsers on the English Penn Treebank (PTB) show that up to 77% of input examples admit adversarial perturbations, and we also show that the robustness of parsing models can be improved by crafting high-quality adversaries and including them in the training stage, while suffering little to no performance drop on the clean input data.

title_zh: 在对话中生成具有特定情感的响应
title_en: Generating Responses with a Specific Emotion in Dialog
authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Mu Xu；Xuanjing Huang；Lu Liu；Zhenqiao Song
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 对话系统希望能够在对话过程中表达特定的情绪，这对其可用性和用户满意度的提高有着直接的、可量化的影响。经过对现实生活中的对话数据的仔细研究，我们发现至少有两种用语言表达情绪的方式。一是明确地使用强烈的情绪词来描述情绪状态；二是通过语言来表达情绪。另一种是通过以不同的方式隐式组合中性词来增加情感体验的强度。我们提出了一种情感对话系统（EmoDS），它可以为帖子生成具有连贯结构的有意义的响应，同时在统一的框架内显式或隐式地表达所需的情感。
abstract_en: It is desirable for dialog systems to have capability to express specific emotions during a conversation, which has a direct, quantifiable impact on improvement of their usability and user satisfaction.After a careful investigation of real-life conversation data, we found that there are at least two ways to express emotions with language.One is to describe emotional states by explicitly using strong emotional words; another is to increase the intensity of the emotional experiences by implicitly combining neutral words in distinct ways.We propose an emotional dialogue system (EmoDS) that can generate the meaningful responses with a coherent structure for a post, and meanwhile express the desired emotion explicitly or implicitly within a unified framework.Experimental results showed EmoDS performed better than the baselines in BLEU, diversity and the quality of emotional expression.

title_zh: 单词和上下文表示之间的几何关系
title_en: Geometric Relationship between Word and Context Representations
authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Jiangtao Feng
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 预训练的分布式单词表示已被证明在各种自然语言处理 (NLP) 任务中非常有用。然而，单词表示的几何基础及其与单词上下文表示的关系尚未得到仔细研究。在本研究中，我们首先在从一些典型的单词表示学习方法中抽象出来的通用框架下研究这种几何关系，并发现只有单词表示的方向与其上下文向量表示有很好的关联，而幅度却没有。为了更好地利用单词表示幅度中包含的信息，我们提出了一种结合了层次高斯模型......
abstract_en: Pre-trained distributed word representations have been proven to be useful in various natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, the geometric basis of word representations and their relations to the representations of word's contexts has not been carefully studied yet. In this study, we first investigate such geometric relationship under a general framework, which is abstracted from some typical word representation learning approaches, and find out that only the directions of word representations are well associated to their context vector representations while the magnitudes are not. In order to make better use of the information contained in the magnitudes of word representations, we propose a hierarchical Gaussian model combined with maximum a posteriori estimation to learn word representations, and extend it to represent polysemous words. Our word representations have been evaluated on multiple NLP tasks, and the experimental results show that the proposed model achieved promising results, comparing to several popular word representations.

title_zh: 基于 RNN 的序列保留注意力依存分析
title_en: RNN-Based Sequence-Preserved Attention for Dependency Parsing
authors: Haoyuan Peng；Yi Zhou；Xiaoqing Zheng；Lu Liu；Jiangtao Feng；Junying Zhou
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 循环神经网络（RNN）与注意力机制相结合已被证明可用于各种 NLP 任务，包括机器翻译、序列标记和句法解析。注意力机制通常通过估计输入的权重（或重要性）并将输入的加权和作为派生特征来应用。尽管这些特征已经证明了它们的有效性，但由于使用简单的加权和来生成它们，它们可能无法捕获序列信息。单词的顺序确实对句子的含义或结构很重要，尤其是对于句法分析来说，其目的是从单词序列中恢复结构。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种基于 RNN 的注意力来捕获......
abstract_en: Recurrent neural networks (RNN) combined with attention mechanism has proved to be useful for various NLP tasks including machine translation, sequence labeling and syntactic parsing. The attention mechanism is usually applied by estimating the weights (or importance) of inputs and taking the weighted sum of inputs as derived features. Although such features have demonstrated their effectiveness, they may fail to capture the sequence information due to the simple weighted sum being used to produce them. The order of the words does matter to the meaning or the structure of the sentences, especially for syntactic parsing, which aims to recover the structure from a sequence of words. In this study, we propose an RNN-based attention to capture the relevant and sequence-preserved features from a sentence, and use the derived features to perform the dependency parsing. We evaluated the graph-based and transition-based parsing models enhanced with the RNN-based sequence-preserved attention on the both English PTB and Chinese CTB datasets. The experimental results show that the enhanced systems were improved with significant increase in parsing accuracy.

title_zh: 项目Rank：一种基于潜在狄利克雷分配的互联网话题评价模型
title_en: Project Rank: An Internet Topic Evaluation Model Based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation
venue: International Conference on Computer Science & Education (ICCSE)
authors: Wenxing Hong；Xiaoqing Zheng；Jianwei Qi；Weiwei Wang；Yang Weng
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 随着互联网相关产业的快速发展，网络新闻包含的信息越来越多，也越来越受到人们的关注。为了探索新闻之间的内在联系并提取有效主题，我们提出了基于潜在狄利克雷分配的ProjectRank模型。大规模中文文本集作为该模型的初始输入。通过将LDA主题模型与概率分布之间的距离相结合，计算出主题的得分，从而量化主题评估的结果。此外，该模型被证明有助于跟踪不同时间段的热点新闻趋势。本文将 ProjectRank 模型应用于从多个网站获得的真实互联网新闻数据...
abstract_en: With the rapid development of Internet-related industries, the Internet news is containing more and more information as well as being paid more attention by human beings. In order to explore the intrinsic links among the news and extracted effective topics, we put forward ProjectRank model based on latent Dirichlet allocation. Large-scale Chinese text sets serves as initial input of this model. By combining LDA topic model with distance between probability distributions, we figure out scores of topics so as to quantify the result of topic evaluation. Moreover, this model proves to be useful to track trends of hot news in different time periods. This paper applies ProjectRank model to real Internet news data obtained from several websites and achieves good experiment results.

title_zh: 用于依存句法分析的基于注意力的置信或置疑特征提取
title_en: Attention-based Belief or Disbelief Feature Extraction for Dependency Parsing
authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Haoyuan Peng；Yi Zhou；Junying Zhou；Lu Liu
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 现有的神经依存解析器通常使用双向 LSTM 对句子中的每个单词进行编码，并根据中心词和修饰语的 LSTM 表示来估计弧的得分，可能会丢失所考虑的弧的相关上下文信息。在本研究中，我们提出了一种神经特征提取方法，可以学习提取特定于弧的特征。我们应用基于神经网络的注意力方法来收集支持和反对每个可能的头部修饰符对的证据，我们的模型用该方法计算相信和不相信的确定性分数，并通过从相信的分数中减去不相信的分数来确定最终的弧分数。通过明确引入两种证据，弧候选者可以再次竞争......
abstract_en: Existing neural dependency parsers usually encode each word in a sentence with bi-directional LSTMs, and estimate the score of an arc from the LSTM representations of the head and the modifier, possibly missing relevant context information for the arc being considered. In this study, we propose a neural feature extraction method that learns to extract arc-specific features. We apply a neural network-based attention method to collect evidences for and against each possible head-modifier pair, with which our model computes certainty scores of belief and disbelief, and determines the final arc score by subtracting the score of disbelief from the one of belief. By explicitly introducing two kinds of evidences, the arc candidates can compete against each other based on more relevant information, especially for the cases where they share the same head or modifier. It makes possible to better discriminate two or more competing arcs by presenting their rivals (disbelief evidence). Experiments on various datasets show that our arc-specific feature extraction mechanism significantly improves the performance of bi-directional LSTM-based models by explicitly modeling long-distance dependencies. For both English and Chinese, the proposed model achieve a higher accuracy on dependency parsing task than most existing neural attention-based models.

title_zh: FinancialFlow：基于分层狄利克雷过程的财经新闻可视化分析
title_en: FinancialFlow: Visual analytics of financial news based on hierarchical dirichlet process
venue: Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
authors: Wenxing Hong；Xiaoqing Zheng；Jianwei Qi；Weiwei Wang；Nannan Zheng；Yang Weng
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 主题演化分析是文本挖掘中的一项重要任务，可以帮助人们理解大型文本集合中潜在主题之间的复杂关系，并发现有趣的主题演化模式。由于大多数主题演化研究都是在开放数据集上进行的，而在金融领域的文本可视化方面取得的成果很少，我们提出了一种名为 FinancialFlow 的可视化主题模型来探索财经新闻中的主题演化模式。我们的模型可以描述为主题建模算法和文本可视化技术的集成，其关键是采用分层狄利克雷过程来发现具有时间信息的文本数据中的连贯主题，然后可视化顶部的过程。
abstract_en: Topic evolution analysis is an important task in text mining to help people understand complex relationships between latent topics in large text collections and discover interesting topic evolution patterns. As most of the studies of topic evolution are made on open data set and few achievements are gained on textual visualization in the domain of finance, we propose a visual topic model named FinancialFlow to explore topic evolution patterns from financial news. Our model can be described as an integration of topic modeling algorithms and text visualization techniques, the key of which is to employ the hierarchical Dirichlet process to discover coherent topics in text data with temporal information and then visualize the process of how topics emerge, decline and develop in the form of flows. Finally, model evaluation and experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of our proposed method in the real-world financial news data.

abstract_zh: 最近，一些关于神经依存解析器的研究在多种语言上显示出优于传统解析器的优势。然而，对于基于图的神经依存解析系统，它们要么依靠长期记忆和注意力机制来隐式捕获高阶特征，要么放弃全局穷举推理算法，以便利用丰富的解析决策历史中的特征。前者可能在没有显式结构信息的帮助下错过特定词条预测的重要特征，而后者可能会遭受错误传播的影响因为在进行未来预测时，错误的早期结构约束被用来创建特征。我们探索可行性......
abstract_en: Very recently, some studies on neural dependency parsers have shown advantage over the traditional ones on a wide variety of languages.However, for graphbased neural dependency parsing systems, they either count on the long-term memory and attention mechanism to implicitly capture the high-order features or give up the global exhaustive inference algorithms in order to harness the features over a rich history of parsing decisions.The former might miss out the important features for specific headword predictions without the help of the explicit structural information, and the latter may suffer from the error propagation as false early structural constraints are used to create features when making future predictions.We explore the feasibility of explicitly taking high-order features into account while remaining the main advantage of global inference and learning for graph-based parsing.The proposed parser first forms an initial parse tree by head-modifier predictions based on the first-order factorization.High-order features (such as grandparent, sibling, and uncle) then can be defined over the initial tree, and used to refine the parse tree in an iterative fashion.Experimental results showed that our model (called INDP) archived competitive performance to existing benchmark parsers on both English and Chinese datasets.

title_zh: 学习上下文特定的单词/字符嵌入
title_en: Learning Context-Specific Word/Character Embeddings
authors: Haoyuan Peng；Xiaoqing Zheng；Wenqing Zhang；Jiangtao Feng；Yi Chen
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 脑电基础大模型
abstract_zh: 无监督词表示已证明在各种 NLP 任务的预测泛化方面有所改进。事实上，大多数现有模型都擅长捕获单词之间的相关性，而不是它们“真正”的相似性，因为上下文表示通常由邻居嵌入的总和（或平均值）来表示，这简化了计算，但忽略了一个重要事实，即单词的含义是由其上下文决定的，不仅反映了周围的单词，还反映了用于组合它们的规则（即组合性）。另一方面，人们付出了很多努力来学习每个单词的单一原型表示，这是有问题的，因为许多单词是多义的，并且...
abstract_en: Unsupervised word representations have demonstrated improvements in predictive generalization on various NLP tasks. Most of the existing models are in fact good at capturing the relatedness among words rather than their ''genuine'' similarity because the context representations are often represented by a sum (or an average) of the neighbor's embeddings, which simplifies the computation but ignores an important fact that the meaning of a word is determined by its context, reflecting not only the surrounding words but also the rules used to combine them (i.e. compositionality). On the other hand, much effort has been devoted to learning a single-prototype representation per word, which is problematic because many words are polysemous, and a single-prototype model is incapable of capturing phenomena of homonymy and polysemy. We present a neural network architecture to jointly learn word embeddings and context representations from large data sets. The explicitly produced context representations are further used to learn context-specific and multi-prototype word embeddings. Our embeddings were evaluated on several NLP tasks, and the experimental results demonstrated the proposed model outperformed other competitors and is applicable to intrinsically "character-based" languages.

abstract_zh: 无监督词表示已证明在各种 NLP 任务的预测泛化方面有所改进。人们在有效学习词嵌入方面投入了大量精力，但很少关注分布式字符表示，尽管这种字符级表示对于本质上基于字符的语言（例如中文和日语）中的各种 NLP 应用非常有用。另一方面，大多数现有模型为每个单词创建单一原型表示，这是有问题的，因为许多单词实际上是多义的，并且单一原型模型无法捕获同名和多义现象。我们提出了一种神经网络架构来共同学习特征...
abstract_en: Unsupervised word representations have demonstrated improvements in predictive generalization on various NLP tasks. Much effort has been devoted to effectively learning word embeddings, but little attention has been given to distributed character representations, although such character-level representations could be very useful for a variety of NLP applications in intrinsically character-based languages (e.g. Chinese and Japanese). On the other hand, most of existing models create a single-prototype representation per word, which is problematic because many words are in fact polysemous, and a single-prototype model is incapable of capturing phenomena of homonymy and polysemy. We present a neural network architecture to jointly learn character embeddings and induce context representations from large data sets. The explicitly produced context representations are further used to learn context-specific and multiple-prototype character embeddings, particularly capturing their polysemous variants. Our character embeddings were evaluated on three NLP tasks of character similarity, word segmentation and named entity recognition, and the experimental results demonstrated the proposed method outperformed other competing ones on all the three tasks.

title_zh: 使用卷积神经网络进行基于字符的解析
title_en: Character-Based Parsing with Convolutional Neural Network
authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Haoyuan Peng；Pengjing Zhang；Wenqiang Zhang；Yi Chen
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种具有 k-max 池化层的新型卷积神经网络架构，能够成功恢复中文句子的结构。该网络可以捕获句子中未见过的片段的活跃特征，以测量这些片段合并为成分的可能性。给定一个输入句子，在计算出所有可能片段的分数后，使用高效的动态规划解析算法来找到全局最优解析树。然后应用类似的网络来预测解析树中每个节点的句法类别。我们的网络在 CTB-5 数据集上向现有基准解析器提供了具有竞争力的性能，而无需任何特定于任务的特征工程。
abstract_en: We describe a novel convolutional neural network architecture with k-max pooling layer that is able to successfully recover the structure of Chinese sentences. This network can capture active features for unseen segments of a sentence to measure how likely the segments are merged to be the constituents. Given an input sentence, after all the scores of possible segments are computed, an efficient dynamic programming parsing algorithm is used to find the globally optimal parse tree. A similar network is then applied to predict syntactic categories for every node in the parse tree. Our networks archived competitive performance to existing benchmark parsers on the CTB-5 dataset without any task-specific feature engineering.

title_zh: 用于音乐建模的深度神经网络
title_en: A Deep Neural Network for Modeling Music
authors: Shangtong Zhang；Sheng Qian；Pengjing Zhang；Wenqi He；Xiaoqing Zheng；Ziyuan Wang；Siyan Li；Wenqiang Zhang
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种具有 k-max 池化层的卷积神经网络架构，用于音乐语义建模。音乐模型的目的是分析和表示音乐的语义内容，以实现分类、发现或聚类的目的。网络中使用 k-max 池化层，可以池化 k 个最活跃的特征，捕获有关音乐的语义丰富且随时间变化的信息。我们的网络将输入音乐视为音频单词序列，其中每个音频单词都与一个分布式特征向量相关联，该特征向量可以在训练期间通过反向传播误差进行微调。该架构使我们能够利用训练有素的音频词嵌入和深层结构来生成......
abstract_en: We propose a convolutional neural network architecture with k-max pooling layer for semantic modeling of music. The aim of a music model is to analyze and represent the semantic content of music for purposes of classification, discovery, or clustering. The k-max pooling layer is used in the network to make it possible to pool the k most active features, capturing the semantic-rich and time-varying information about music. Our network takes an input music as a sequence of audio words, where each audio word is associated with a distributed feature vector that can be fine-tuned by backpropagating errors during the training. The architecture allows us to take advantage of the better trained audio word embeddings and the deep structures to produce more robust music representations. Experiment results with two different music collections show that our neural networks achieved the best accuracy in music genre classification comparing with three state-of-art systems.

title_zh: 中文分词和词性标注的深度学习
title_en: Deep Learning for Chinese Word Segmentation and POS Tagging
authors: Tianyu Xu；Xiaoqing Zheng；Hanyang Chen
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法

abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了通过深度学习执行中文分词（CWS）和词性标注的可行性。我们尝试避免特定于任务的特征工程，并使用深层神经网络来发现任务的相关特征。我们利用大规模未标记数据来改进汉字的内部表示，并使用这些改进的表示来增强监督分词和词性标注模型。我们的网络以最小的计算成本实现了接近最先进的性能。我们还描述了一种用于训练神经网络的感知器式算法网络作为最大似然方法的替代方法，可以加快训练过程并使学习算法更容易实现。
abstract_en: This study explores the feasibility of performing Chinese word segmentation (CWS) and POS tagging by deep learning.We try to avoid task-specific feature engineering, and use deep layers of neural networks to discover relevant features to the tasks.We leverage large-scale unlabeled data to improve internal representation of Chinese characters, and use these improved representations to enhance supervised word segmentation and POS tagging models.Our networks achieved close to state-of-theart performance with minimal computational cost.We also describe a perceptron-style algorithm for training the neural networks, as an alternative to maximum-likelihood method, to speed up the training process and make the learning algorithm easier to be implemented.

title_zh: 基于结构语义熵的网页数据提取
title_en: Data extraction from web pages based on structural-semantic entropy
authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Yiling Gu；Yinsheng Li
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 当今的大多数网络内容都是为人类消费而设计的，这使得软件工具很难轻松访问它们。即使是从后端数据库自动生成的网页内容通常也没有原始结构信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种自动信息提取算法，可以从不同站点的产品描述中提取相关的属性值对。结构语义熵的概念用于定位网页上感兴趣的数据，它衡量相关信息在网页的 DOM 树表示上出现的密度。我们的方法劳动密集度较低，并且对网页格式的变化不敏感。实验...
abstract_en: Most of today's web content is designed for human consumption, which makes it difficult for software tools to access them readily. Even web content that is automatically generated from back-end databases is usually presented without the original structural information. In this paper, we present an automated information extraction algorithm that can extract the relevant attribute-value pairs from product descriptions across different sites. A notion, called structural-semantic entropy, is used to locate the data of interest on web pages, which measures the density of occurrence of relevant information on the DOM tree representation of web pages. Our approach is less labor-intensive and insensitive to changes in web-page format. Experimental results on a large number of real-life web page collections are encouraging and confirm the feasibility of the approach, which has been successfully applied to detect false drug advertisements on the web due to its capacity in associating the attributes of records with their respective values.

authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Stuart E. Madnick；Xitong Li
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 许多语义 Web 应用程序需要集成来自分布式和自治 RDF 数据源的数据。然而，RDF 三元组中的值经常被简单地记录为文字，并且通常会省略诸如单位和格式之类的附加上下文信息，这依赖于对上下文的一致理解。在更广泛的网络环境中，做出这种假设通常是不安全的。上下文交换策略提供了一种用于中介数据访问的系统方法，其中异构数据源之间的语义冲突由上下文中介器自动检测和协调。在本文中，我们展示了涉及源自不同上下文的多个 RDF 图的 SPARQL 查询可以...
abstract_en: Many Semantic Web applications require the integration of data from distributed and autonomous RDF data sources. However, the values in the RDF triples would be frequently recorded simply as the literal, and additional contextual information such as unit and format is often omitted, relying on consistent understanding of the context. In the wider context of the Web, it is generally not safe to make this assumption. The Context Interchange strategy provides a systematic approach for mediated data access in which semantic conflicts among heterogeneous data sources are automatically detected and reconciled by a context mediator. In this paper, we show that SPARQL queries that involve multiple RDF graphs originating from different contexts can be mediated in the way using the Context Interchange (COIN) Framework.

abstract_zh: 语义 Web 提供了一组有前途的技术，可以使复杂的数据集成变得更加容易，因为语义 Web 上的数据可以通过链接进行连接，并且可以针对这些链接数据的数据集执行复杂的查询。尽管语义Web技术提供RDF/OWL来支持不同数据源之间的示意性映射，但大规模数据集成仍然受到数据源之间各种类型的数据级语义异构性的严重阻碍。在本文中，我们展示了可以自动调解旨在在多个异构数据源上执行的 SPARQL 查询。 1.
abstract_en: The Semantic Web provides a set of promising technologies to make sophisticated data integration much easier, because data on the semantic Web is allowed to be connected by links and complex queries can be executed against the dataset of those linked data. Although the Semantic Web techniques offer RDF/OWL to support schematic mappings between diverse data sources, large-scale data integration is still severely hampered by various types of data-level semantic heterogeneity among the data sources. In the paper, we show that SPARQL queries that are intended to execute over multiple heterogeneous data sources can be mediated automatically. 1.

abstract_zh: 一些有问题的案例，例如集体失败和奇数长度的失败周期，目前所有非单调推理的理论（包括默认逻辑和限制）往往会错误地处理这些案例，这些案例在文献中已得到充分认识。尽管在自动失效推理机 OSCAR 中提出了一种强大的基于论证的方法，并且他们声称该理论能够正确地推理最重要的问题，但通过仔细的调查，我们并不认为它完全正确。这似乎是认知推理与实践推理脱节以及没有充分考虑决策可能产生的后果和个人偏好的后果。继...
abstract_en: Some problematic cases, such as collective defeat and odd-length defeat cycles, which tend to be handled incorrectly by all of the current theories of no monotonic reasoning, including default logic and circumscription, have been well recognized in the literature. Although a powerful argument-based approach in the automated defeasible reasoner OSCAR has been proposed and they claim that this theory is able to reason correctly for the problems above all, but we don't consider it to be true completely through careful investigation. It seems to be the consequences of disconnection between epistemic reasoning and practical reasoning and not considering the possible consequences of the decision and individual preferences sufficiently. Following these observations, we propose a scalable probabilistic approach based on Bayesian decision theory that can solve all of the above paradoxes properly and has successfully been used in web of trust and knowledge integration for semantic Grid.

abstract_zh: 如今，越来越多的研究集中在语义网的信任管理上。多智能体系统、社交网络分析、人工智能等多个领域的一些成熟技术已被引入该领域。然而，语义网的一些独特特征或多或少被忽视了。在本文中，我们尝试探索信任管理的语义方面。我们提出了 DartTrust，这是中医 (TCM) 应用背景下语义网络的信任原型。我们引入了 RCSW——一种语义网信誉链信任模型，它结合了成对的信任因子和可靠因子，并构建了边加权图来计算信任评级。我们定义一个...
abstract_en: Nowadays, more and more research has focused on the trust management of the Semantic Web. Some mature technologies from many fields such as multiagent systems, social network analysis and artificial intelligence have been introduced to this field. However, some unique characteristics of the Semantic Web are more or less ignored. In this paper, we try to explore the semantic aspects of the trust management. We present DartTrust, a trust prototype for the semantic web in the application context of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). We introduce RCSW - a Reputation-Chain trust model for the Semantic Web, which incorporates pairwise trust factor and reliable factor and constructs an edge-weighted graph to calculate trust ratings. We define a small trust ontology to illustrate the trust relationships. The trust ontology is described in OWL that can be understood and processed by machines. Therefore, DartTrust can provide reasoning functions and facilitate trust management with little human effort. As a demonstration of the prototype, we present its implementation on Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) at the end of this paper.

abstract_zh: 语义网被视为代理的集合，为信任研究带来了新的机遇和挑战。实现信任以确保更有效和高效的交互是语义网愿景的核心。我们提出了一种基于统计决策理论和贝叶斯序贯分析的复合信任模型，以平衡信任评估过程中的成本和收益，并结合多种信息源，帮助用户根据自己的偏好做出正确的决策，选择合适的服务提供商。本文提出的模型从概率论角度给了信任一个严格的数学解释。
abstract_en: The Semantic Web, conceived as a collection of agents, brings new opportunities and challenges to trust research. Enabling trust to ensure more effective and efficient interaction is at the heart of the Semantic Web vision. We propose a composite trust model based on statistical decision theory and Bayesian sequential analysis to balance the costs and benefits during the process of trust evaluating and combine a variety of sources of information to assist users with making the correct decisions in selecting the appropriate service providers according to their preferences. The model proposed by this paper gives trust a strict mathematical interpretation in terms of probability theory.

authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Zhaohui Wu；Huajun Chen；Yu Zhang
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 信任对于语义 Web 上高效、安全的交互起着核心作用。如今，越来越多的研究集中在这个话题上。在本文中，我们介绍了 RCSW，一种用于语义 Web 的声誉链信任模型。我们阐述了 RCSW 的基本定义和机制，并提出了通过信任网络链计算信任评级的算法。 RCSW结合了成对的信任值和熟人的可靠因素，并构建了边加权图来计算信任评级。我们还定义了信任函数的类别，以允许用户个性化他们的信任计算。我们提出的模型可以有效地处理信任管理，并且可以快速适应不断变化的环境。
abstract_en: Trust plays a central role for efficient and secure interactions on the semantic Web. Nowadays, more and more research has focused on this topic. In this paper, we introduce RCSW, a reputation-chain trust model for the semantic Web. We illustrate the basic definitions and mechanisms of RCSW and present the algorithm to calculate trust ratings through the chain of the trust network. RCSW incorporates pairwise trust values and reliable factors of acquaintances and constructs an edge-weighted graph to calculate trust ratings. We also define classes of trust functions to allow users to individualize their trust calculation. Our proposed model can deal with trust management effectively and can quickly adapt to the changing environment.

title_zh: 语义网格中的知识融合
title_en: Knowledge Fusion in Semantic Grid
authors: Xiaoqing Zheng；Zhaohui Wu；Huajun Chen
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 正如网络正在将其焦点从信息和通信转移，并强调知识重用作为一个巨大的分布式知识库的必要性一样，赋予信息和服务明确定义含义的语义网格扩展了当前的网格，使软件智能体、用户和程序能够协作工作。如何处理不同来源的信息，特别是结合多种来源的知识来协助用户进行有效推理或协作解决问题，是实现上述愿景的一大障碍。在此背景下，我们提出了一种基于统计决策理论和贝叶斯分析的语义网格知识融合和集成方法
abstract_en: Just as the Web is shifting its focus from information and communication and emphasizes the need to reuse of knowledge as a huge distributed knowledge base, the semantic grid in which information and services are given well-defined meaning extends the current grid to enable software agents, users, and programs to work in cooperation. How to process the different sources of information, in particular, to combine a variety of sources of knowledge to assist users with effective reasoning or collaborative problem-solving, is one of great barrier in realizing the above vision. Against this background, we propose a knowledge fusion and integration approach based on statistical decision theory and Bayesian analysis for the semantic grid
